fullPassage: What is the Capabilities Approach (CA), and why would lawyers passionate about animal justice care about it? It is easy to say what it is not. The CA does not rank animals by likeness to humans or seek special privileges for those considered most "like us," as do some other popular theoretical approaches. The CA has concern for the finch and the pig as much as the whale and the elephant. And it argues that the human form of life is simply irrelevant when we think about what each type of animal needs and deserves. What is relevant is their own forms of life. Just as humans seek to be able to enjoy the characteristic goods of a human life, so a finch seeks a finch's life and the whale a whale's life. We should extend ourselves and learn, not lazily picture animals as lesser humans, seeking a life sort of like our own. According to the CA, each sentient creature should have the opportunity to flourish in its own way, according to its own form of life.

questions.passage: What is the Capabilities Approach (CA), and why would lawyers ①<u>passionate</u> about animal justice care about it? It is easy to say what it is not. The CA does not rank animals by likeness to humans or seek special privileges for those ②<u>considered</u> most "like us," as do some other popular theoretical approaches. The CA has concern for the finch and the pig as much as the whale and the elephant. And it argues ③<u>that</u> the human form of life is simply irrelevant when we think about what each type of animal needs and deserves. What is relevant is ④<u>their</u> own forms of life. Just as humans seek to be able to enjoy the characteristic goods of a human life, so a finch seeks a finch's life and the whale a whale's life. We should extend ourselves and learn, not lazily picture animals as lesser humans, seeking a life sort of like our own. According to the CA, each sentient creature should have the opportunity to flourish in its own way, according to its own form of life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①열정적인 ②여겨지는 ③~라는 것(→what) ④그들의
det.analysis:
❌ ③ that → what: 명사절 안에서 needs/deserves의 목적어 자리. 선행사 없는 명사절+절 안 목적어 → what
✅ ① passionate: lawyers 후치 수식
✅ ② considered: those (who are) considered
✅ ④ their: forms of life의 소유격
det.tip: 선행사 없는 + 절 안 목적어 = what
